author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಣ್ಣಬದಲಿಸಬೇಡ ತೊಂಡೆಯಂದದಿ ನೀನು
ಸಣ್ಣತನ ಮಾನವಗೆ ಶೋಭೆಯನು ತರದು
ಮಣ್ಣುಧನ ಮುಖ್ಯದಲಿ ಮನಸುಗಳ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿರೆ
ಹುಣ್ಣದುವೆ ಗುಣಪಡಿಸು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t change your colour like the ivy gourd;
pettiness brings no grace to a person;
if you turn people’s minds with land and money as the main thing,
that is a wound: heal it, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Don’t be fickle, changing colour like the tondekai gourd as it ripens. Small-mindedness is unbecoming. Making land and money the measure of everything wounds relationships; heal that.
